evidence.summary: Rounds 1-2 unchanged. Round 3: every observation says why its payload was kept or not (parse_flags.snapshot_stored = first_observation/changed/fetch_failed/parse_failed/status_transition, or snapshot_skipped='unchanged' with unchanged_since_observation_id); retention marks cleared rows with parse_flags.snapshot_cleared {reason, retention_days, cleared_at} and returns/logs cutoff, batches, snapshots_cleared, bytes_cleared, rows_deleted (always 0), stopped_reason and duration; reparse logs skipped payload-less rows. The per-run, per-marketplace, per-reason storage breakdown in N0101_IMPL.md was derived from these flags alone (N0101_r3b_live_breakdown.py). Worker log read this round through cip-supervisor-status.ps1.
